indexability: Important pages can be crawled where intended.
Robots directives and sitemap entries are consistent.
migration_integrity: Important legacy URLs map to relevant destinations.
Important content and metadata are preserved or intentionally updated.
Broken internal links and redirect chains are detected.
Canonical and sitemap references reflect the intended URL structure.
search_performance: Search queries where reporting is available
content_quality: Pages answer their intended audience's needs.
Important content is not duplicated without a reason.
Metadata accurately represents visible page content.

investigate: Increase in crawl or redirect errors
Important URL changes without expected redirects
Missing titles or descriptions on important pages

rules: Use verified analytics and search platform data when available.
Account for seasonality, reporting delays, algorithm changes, and other external factors.
Do not promise rankings or traffic growth.
Do not automatically rewrite important content solely because a metric changes.
Require review before material changes to high-value pages.
Keep SEO monitoring separate from clinical or business performance claims.
Treat unavailable search data as unknown.
